manifest.name: dsh-suggest
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: predicts your next prompt after each turn; press Tab in the composer to accept it.
manifest.author: Jeff Ding (https://github.com/dinjufen)

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-suggest
      name: 'dsh-suggest'
      config:
        maxOutputTokens: 64
        timeoutMs: 20000
        includeTools: true

readme.text: **中文** | [English](README.en.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-suggest) 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上类似 Claude Code 的「下一步提示词建议」。每轮回复结束后，插件会预测你接下来可能输入的内容，显示在输入框上方，按 **Tab** 就能填进输入框。

- 每轮回复结束后，在输入框上方显示一条预测的下一句，例如「跑一下测试」「加上单元测试吧」。
- 在输入框里按 **Tab**，或点一下提示条，会把建议填进草稿。这次插入可以撤销。
- 点提示条右侧的 **×** 会关闭本轮建议。之后 Tab 恢复原生行为，直到下一轮回复结束。
- 在 **设置 → 通用设置 → 提示词建议** 里可以关闭整个功能（默认开启），切换后立即生效，不用重启。
- 中英文都适用，建议会跟随你的语言和说话风格。
需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3** 及以上的 0.2.x 版本。插件已发布到 npm：[`dsh-suggest`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-suggest)。

readme.section: 方式一：在 DeepSeek Harness 里添加（推荐）
readme.text: **1. 打开左侧的「插件」页，点右上角的「添加插件」。** **2. 输入包名 `dsh-suggest`，点「安装」。** 安装源保持「npm 官方源」即可；访问 npm 慢时，可以在右侧切换到 npmmirror 镜像。 **3. 安装完成后，点「立即启用」。** **4. 「已安装插件」里出现 DSH Suggest，开关处于打开状态，就可以用了。**

readme.section: 方式一：在 DeepSeek Harness 里添加（推荐）
readme.text: 在客户端里安装会立即生效；如果建议没有出现，刷新一下页面或重启客户端。

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-suggest
```

用命令行安装后需要重启客户端。卸载：

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-suggest
```

1. 打开 **插件** 页，在「实验性插件」里启用 **自定义插件市场**。
2. 在 **发现** 标签页添加索引地址：

```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dinjufen/dsh-suggest/main/market.json
   ```

3. 在列表里找到 **DSH Suggest**，点安装。

> 从 0.2.0 升级：0.2.0 的包名是 `dsh-next-prompt`（只在 GitHub 上发布过），0.3.0 起改名为 `dsh-suggest`。请先 `remove dsh-next-prompt`，再按上面的方法安装。注意 npm 上的 `dsh-next-prompt` 是另一位作者的同类插件，不是这个项目。
**1. 正常对话。每轮回复结束后，输入框上方会出现一条建议**，就像本页开头的截图那样。 **2. 在输入框里按 Tab（或点一下建议），它就会填进输入框，可以直接发送，也可以先改一改。** 不想要这条建议时，点右侧的 ×。 **3. 想关闭这个功能：左下角头像 → 设置 → 通用设置 → 提示词建议。** 下一步不明显时，模型可能不给建议，这时提示条不会出现。

- **Host（`index.js`）**：提供一个远程方法 `dshSuggest.suggest({ sessionId })`。它原样复用会话最近一次发给模型的请求头、消息历史、工具定义和 `toolHistory`，只在末尾追加一条预测指令（`suggestion.js`），再用同一个模型请求一次。这次请求最多输出 64 个 token，并使用最低推理强度。请求前缀和主对话逐字一致，所以绝大部分输入 token 能命中 DeepSeek 的上下文缓存，实测约 93%。整个过程不写会话日志，模型下一轮看不到这次请求。
- **过滤（`suggestion.js`）**：先去掉「建议：」前缀、引号和标签，再丢弃以下结果：空回复、评价类（谢谢、不错）、助手口吻（我来、让我）、问句、多句话、超长或带格式的内容。
- **Client（`client.js`）**：提示条挂在 `conversation.input.overlay` slot，看到一轮回复结束时请求一次建议。Tab 用 `ctx.shortcuts.observeFixedInput` 截获，只在这个输入框里、且当前有建议时才生效。设置页那一行挂在 `settings.general.item` slot。
- **设置开关**：`enabled` 是插件配置里的 volatile 字段。设置服务把它写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，运行中的插件会立刻读到新值。
- **加载内置包（`shipped.js`）**：插件以 Host 启动脚本所在的安装目录为基准解析 `@deepseek-ai/*` 和 `zod`，并按 `exports` 选 ESM 入口，确保和宿主用的是同一份。

可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖配置：

```yaml
- id: dsh-suggest
  name: dsh-suggest
  config:
    enabled: true           # 总开关，也可以在 设置 → 通用设置 → 提示词建议 里切换

注意：覆盖配置会替换整个 `config`，没写的字段会回落到默认值。

- 插件基于 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 的内部接口编写，Typert 清单是手写的。客户端升级后可能需要适配。
- 只有亲眼看到一轮回复结束时才会请求建议。刷新页面或切到旧会话不会触发，以免产生额外费用。
- 同一个会话不能同时在桌面版和 Web 版里打开，这是 DeepSeek Harness 自身的限制。
- 不要和其他同样拦截输入框 Tab 键的提示词建议插件同时安装（例如 npm 上的 `dsh-next-prompt`），它们会抢同一个按键。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dinjufen/dsh-suggest.git
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD/dsh-suggest"
```

`link:` 安装会直接使用本地目录：改了 `client.js` 刷新页面即可，改了 `index.js` 需要重启客户端。
MIT。`client.js` 内含一份 DeepSeek Harness `remote-info.js` 的拷贝（MIT），详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

[中文](README.md) | **English** [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-suggest) Next-prompt suggestions for DeepSeek Harness, similar to Claude Code's. After each turn, the plugin predicts what you are likely to type next and shows it above the composer. Press **Tab** to put it in the composer.

- After each turn, a predicted next prompt appears above the composer, such as "run the tests" or "Yes, add unit tests".
- Press **Tab** in the composer, or click the suggestion, to insert it into your draft. The insertion can be undone.
- Click the **×** on the right of the suggestion to dismiss it for this turn. Tab then behaves normally until the next turn ends.
- Turn the whole feature off in **Settings → General → Prompt suggestions** (on by default). The change applies immediately, with no restart.
- Works in Chinese and English; suggestions follow your language and writing style.
Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3** or a later 0.2.x release. Published on npm as [`dsh-suggest`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-suggest).

readme.section: Option 1: add it in DeepSeek Harness (recommended)
readme.text: **1. Open Plugins in the sidebar and click Add plugin in the top right.** **2. Enter the package name `dsh-suggest` and click Install.** Keep the registry on "Official npm registry"; if npm is slow for you, switch to the npmmirror mirror in the registry menu.

readme.text: **3. When it says Installed, click Enable now.** **4. DSH Suggest now appears under Installed plugins with its switch on. You're ready.** Installing from inside the app takes effect right away; if no suggestion shows up, reload the page or restart the app.

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-suggest
```

Restart the app after a command-line install. To uninstall:

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-suggest
```

1. Open **Plugins** and enable **Custom plugin markets** under Experimental plugins.
2. On the **Discover** tab, add this index source:

```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dinjufen/dsh-suggest/main/market.json
   ```

3. Find **DSH Suggest** in the list and click **Install**.

> Upgrading from 0.2.0: 0.2.0 was named `dsh-next-prompt` (published on GitHub only); from 0.3.0 the package is `dsh-suggest`. Run `remove dsh-next-prompt` first, then install as above. Note that `dsh-next-prompt` on npm is a similar plugin by another author, not this project.

**1. Chat as usual. When a turn ends, a suggestion appears above the composer**, as in the screenshot at the top of this page. **2. Press Tab in the composer (or click the suggestion) to put it in your draft, then send it as is or edit it first.** Click × to dismiss a suggestion you don't want.
**3. To turn the feature off: avatar in the bottom left → Settings → General → Prompt suggestions.** When the next step isn't obvious, the model may not suggest anything, and no suggestion is shown.

- **Host (`index.js`)**: exposes one remote method, `dshSuggest.suggest({ sessionId })`. It reuses the session's latest model request unchanged (request header, message history, tool definitions and `toolHistory`), appends one prediction instruction (`suggestion.js`) at the end, and sends one more request to the same model. That request is capped at 64 output tokens and uses the lowest reasoning effort. Because its prefix is identical to the main conversation's, most input tokens hit DeepSeek's context cache (about 93% in testing). Nothing is written to the session log, so the model never sees this request in later turns.
- **Filtering (`suggestion.js`)**: strips "Suggestion:" prefixes, quotes and tags, then drops empty replies, evaluations ("thanks", "looks good"), assistant-voice text ("Let me…", "I'll…"), questions, multiple sentences, and over-long or formatted text.
- **Client (`client.js`)**: the suggestion renders in the `conversation.input.overlay` slot and is requested once each time a turn ends. Tab is captured with `ctx.shortcuts.observeFixedInput`, and only in that composer while a suggestion is showing. The Settings row lives in the `settings.general.item` slot.

Override the config in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-suggest
  name: dsh-suggest
  config:
    enabled: true           # master switch, also in Settings → General

Note: an override replaces the whole `config`; fields you leave out fall back to their defaults.

- Built against internal interfaces of DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3, with a hand-written Typert manifest. Later Harness releases may need changes.
- A suggestion is requested only when the client sees a turn end. Reloading the page or opening an older session does not trigger one, to avoid extra cost.
- The same session cannot be open in the desktop app and the web UI at once; this is a DeepSeek Harness limitation.
- Do not install it together with other prompt-suggestion plugins that also intercept Tab in the composer (such as `dsh-next-prompt` on npm); they compete for the same key.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dinjufen/dsh-suggest.git
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD/dsh-suggest"
```

A `link:` install uses your local directory directly: after changing `client.js`, reload the page; after changing `index.js`, restart the app.
MIT. `client.js` contains a copy of DeepSeek Harness's `remote-info.js` (MIT); see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
